q1.a: We integrate 10+ high-quality sources including ProductHunt, Reddit, HackerNews, GitHub, YouTube, ensuring comprehensive coverage of global AI tool dynamics and user pain points.

q2.a: Our automated pipeline runs daily at dawn, fetching the latest AI tools and pain point data, ensuring you see fresh market opportunities every day.

q3.q: How do you ensure data quality?
q3.a: We use advanced LLM models for deep analysis and filtering, implement tiered source weighting, and filter out low-value content through reflection mechanisms, ensuring 70%+ of pain points are real and valuable.

q4.q: Can I cancel my subscription anytime?
q4.a: Yes, you can cancel your subscription anytime through the Stripe customer portal without providing a reason. The subscription will end at the current billing cycle.

q5.q: What's the difference between Beta and paid versions?
q5.a: Beta and paid versions have identical features, both providing full Dashboard access and all data. Beta is our early testing program, accessed for free through invite codes.
